summary: Allow proven managed target takeover during adoption

delivery.outcome: An upgrade may transfer a changed pre-existing target into managed ownership only when the ticket declares its exact base SHA-256 digest
nonGoals: Do not generally allow replacement of pre-existing target files
Do not fetch external provenance during deterministic validation
Do not weaken head lock or managed payload hash verification
Do not include the follow-up release or Platform adoption

architecture.decision: Extend standardAdoption with an optional, exact-path managedTargetTakeovers list whose baseDigest is verified against the accepted Git base and must be consumed exactly once
architecture.rollback: Revert the contract and validator change; pre-existing changed targets return to fail-closed rejection
